// Positive control (#5170): a gate module whose read swallows the failure with an empty catch.
// Parsed as TypeScript by tests/lint-gate-evidence-drift.test.cjs; never compiled (`.txt`).
import fs from 'node:fs';
import { gateVerdict } from './gate-verdict.cjs';

export function evaluateFixtureGate(planPath: string) {
  let text = '';
  try {
    text = fs.readFileSync(planPath, 'utf8');
  } catch {
    // unreadable plan: ignored
  }
  return gateVerdict('pass', false, { text });
}
